title: host.map.json: how the generated adapter drives a poly module (S90)

module.description: The poly module the adapter loads.

instances.description: Each instance the host creates, by name: its machine, and whether it is created at start or by a method (keyed by one of that method's arguments).

createdBy.description: A method name; absent for an instance created when the host is created.

keyArgument.description: The argument of createdBy that names the instance.

init.description: Initial field values, addresses written as instance names.

methods.description: Each host method: the instance it targets, the action it dispatches, and each action parameter's source argument.

instance.description: An instance name, the name of a family of instances a method creates, or $arg:<name> for an argument that names an instance created with the host.

machine.description: With $arg:<name>: the machine of the instances the argument may name.

key.description: For a family: $arg:<name>, the argument that names the member.

returns.description: verdict (the default): { ok: true } or { ok: false, reason }.

queries.description: Each host query: the instance it reads and the fields it returns, renamed as the interface names them.

instance.description: An instance name, the name of a family, or $arg:<name> for an argument that names an instance created with the host.

machine.description: With $arg:<name>: the machine of the instances the argument may name.

key.description: For a family: $arg:<name>, the argument that names the member.
